facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 March 2008 a near hit was recorded on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
